$comment: Every estimator constant lives here (ADR-002 F). Adapters carry no numbers. `measured` is the output of scripts/calibrate.mjs run against the local index (250 files, chars-v1 runs; slopes and k are constant-independent); `calibrationVersion` must change whenever a constant changes (test/ir-calibration.test.mjs pins the sha1 of the constants, i.e. everything but `$comment` and `measured`, next to it).

binary.$comment: Tool results that carry a binary document (a PDF, image, .docx or .xlsx read as base64 or raw bytes): the vendor converts the document before tokenizing, so the text ratios overshoot by an order of magnitude. Fitted on ONE observation: a 532 KB PDF read that the vendor billed at about 13k tokens (147.8k with the prose ratio). Applies in place of the vendor bytes-per-token when a block's kind is `binary`; the vendor envelope / category scale still apply.

measured.method: deltaCheck slope: (input + cacheCreation) vs bytes of new visible blocks, per dominant category, segment starts excluded; constants = previous (2.25 / 2.4) divided by p50 of main-scope scaleRaw (1.062) so the main scope centres on k = 1

envelopeFit.method: trimmed least squares over main-scope requests (ADR-003 section 9): charged = bytes_code / bpt + bytes_prose / bpt + b x envelope-category blocks + c, 3 x MAD trimming; candidates replayed on the ADR-003 reference sessions by recomputing block estimates and re-running reconcileScope (scripts/calibrate.mjs)
envelopeFit.decision: fitted per-block envelope is within 30% of 80 (26%); 101 centres cc87cfe5 but pushes the other two below 1.00, so the constant is kept

measured.method: reconcile scaleRaw p50 per dominant new-block category over non-legacy rollouts (legacy history_mode children and fork bootstraps excluded); scales unchanged: the three largest rollouts already sit at k p50 0.97-1.06

autoCompact.$comment: Auto-compaction threshold as a share of the context window (ADR-003 section 3), measured per (vendor, window) from the compactions in the local index and keyed by window size: a share measured on the 1M window says nothing about a 200k session. The forecast prefers a run's own auto compactions (median preTokens; provenance observed.vendor only when the vendor reported them) and falls back to `byWindow[<window>].share` when it rests on >= 3 events (`estimated.local`), else `defaultShare` (documented working assumption, `estimated.local`). Claude preTokens come from compactMetadata (observed.vendor); Codex preTokens are the previous request's total and the auto trigger is inferred (>= 0.75 x window), so its entries are marked `inferred` and never yield a vendor-observed threshold.

1000000.method: median preTokens / window over trigger:auto compactions on the documented 1M window (shares 0.967, 0.9674, 0.999, 0.9996, 1.000); two events at 1,000,228 and 1,001,760 exceeded 1M (window raised to the peak) and were excluded

200000.note: no auto-compaction on a 200k window in the local corpus; defaultShare applies

258400.method: median preTokens / model_context_window over inferred auto compactions in 7 rollouts (shares 0.815-0.912)
